summary.text: Jermarkus Jacobs is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 6, where he faces Republican incumbent Matt Brass in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to a Ballotpedia survey response, he is a Newnan native who graduated from Georgia State University and previously served as a White House intern.

paragraphs.text: Jacobs graduated from East Coweta High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University in 2026, according to Ballotpedia; his survey response says the degree is in political science with a minor in public policy.
The response says he gained experience in local political campaigns and served as a White House intern in the Office of Presidential Correspondence.
At Georgia State he served as a University-Wide Senator and later as Executive Vice President of the Student Government Association on the Atlanta campus, according to the response.
Jacobs won the 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 6 unopposed, receiving 10,503 votes.
He listed bringing people together, strong schools and workforce development, and putting people ahead of special interests as the main messages of his campaign.
